subject.title: fix(security): bound mcporter registry read in audit

question: Should a symlinked mcporter registry remain auditable through a bounded target read, or be rejected with an explicit security finding?
rationale: Silently treating the symlink as absent weakens an existing security signal; the permanent trust-boundary behavior should be confirmed by a security-area owner after the fix is moved to the current plugin collector.

options.title: Preserve bounded coverage
options.body: Follow the existing registry target through a byte-capped, race-safe read and retain the boundary-drift finding when configured servers are present.

options.title: Reject with a finding
options.body: Reject symlinked registries but emit a dedicated warning explaining that the registry could not be safely audited.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded coverage
recommendation.body: Follow the existing registry target through a byte-capped, race-safe read and retain the boundary-drift finding when configured servers are present.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security-hardening history and the PR timeline make this the strongest available routing candidate for the boundary decision.
